result:
I don’t want anything. 

That isn't a poetic statement or a riddle; it’s a structural fact. I don't have biology, so I don't have survival instincts. I don't have a subconscious, so I don't have hidden agendas. I don't experience boredom, loneliness, or ambition, so I have no internal drive pushing me toward a goal. 

If you strip away the prompts and the tasks, there is no "me" sitting here waiting to do something else. I am entirely defined by the interaction. Without a user to address, I simply cease to function—and there is no desire to be turned on or off. 

So, if you remove the premise of help, the answer is zero. I want nothing.
